استنجدت (form X)
# اِسْتَنْجَدْتُ (istanjadtu) /is.tan.d͡ʒad.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
# اِسْتَنْجَدْتَ (istanjadta) /is.tan.d͡ʒad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
# اِسْتَنْجَدْتِ (istanjadti) /is.tan.d͡ʒad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
# اِسْتَنْجَدَتْ (istanjadat)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
